about: DT-FM 1.2.1 for Digitakt OS 1.53 and 1.54: the author's released .elemod files, pinned unchanged.

mods.title: DT-FM
mods.summary: A four-operator FM synth machine: eight algorithms, drawn on ALGO's knob, with each operator's ratio, level and envelope, and feedback on operator 4. Built for machine-pages, which the shop ticks with it, so it shares a build with other machines made for it. Not with the shop's NEIGHBOR or SOPHIE. From 1.2.0 DT-FM is machine 9: tracks saved as DT-FM by 1.1.0 or earlier load as another machine (SOPHIE if it is installed, else ONESHOT), so select DT-FM on them again.
mods.description: Four-operator FM synth machine for Digitakt Mk1. Audio enters the normal Digitakt AMP, filter, mixer and sends. Its SRC page is drawn by machine-pages, so it combines with other machines built for it.
mods.author: DT-FM contributors
mods.on_unit: Tested on a Digitakt mk1 by its author: 1.2.1 on OS 1.54 with core 3.0, machine-pages 1.1 and digihealth. Earlier, on OS 1.53, four tracks together used about 95% CPU, about 85% with digihealth's FAST AUDIO on. Eight tracks are not claimed.
